required_host_proxy_behavior: accept only the trial-scoped loopback route
set Authorization to Bearer plus the host-held subscription OAuth token
retain the observed Claude Code beta and version headers

conclusions.claim: A trial proxy can broker a static host-held subscription bearer directly: the real CLI authenticates to the trial route with its dummy bearer, FixedUpstream strips container auth, and the capture adapter writes a distinct host-side dummy bearer observed by the synthetic upstream.
The existing gateway is not required for static request-time bearer substitution; P5 instead needs a subscription-OAuth adapter because the current Anthropic adapter only writes x-api-key.
The container input names for the exercised path are ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN; CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN alone did not produce a request in bare mode.

observed.claim: Claude Code 2.1.232 accepts a loopback ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and sends POST /v1/messages?beta=true.
With only dummy ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN auth, the real process sends Authorization: Bearer <dummy> and no x-api-key.
The same real process emits exact sonnet, opus, haiku, and explicit subagent-haiku model identifiers recorded by the fixture.
CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN alone is not a usable dummy input in isolated bare mode: the CLI emits a local authentication_failed terminal result and sends no request.
The real process completed through the actual TrialProxy while the capture adapter received no container auth and the synthetic upstream received a distinct host-side bearer, not the trial dummy.
The current Anthropic adapter cannot perform this substitution because it writes only x-api-key; the exact subscription OAuth registry row is absent.
The capture process could not read the real home and strace observed no non-loopback connect.

unverified: A real host subscription OAuth bearer was not read or sent, so Anthropic acceptance and account entitlements are unverified.
OAuth expiry, refresh, revocation, and live upstream error behavior were not exercised.
The existing gateway was not exercised as a credential broker; only its necessity for static bearer substitution was resolved.
Live model availability, provider-side alias remapping, and fallback behavior remain unverified.
No claim is made that CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN is unsupported outside the isolated bare-mode invocation.
